business: Nexio CRM (a cloud CRM for small Uzbek companies)
target: Owners and sales managers of small companies in Uzbekistan (retail shops and service businesses, 3 to 25 staff) who now keep clients in Excel, Telegram chats, amoCRM or Bitrix24

segments.name: Sales manager at a growing company

behaviours.name: Runs it from Telegram
behaviours.how: Handles every client in Telegram chats and a notebook; has never used a CRM.

behaviours.name: Excel keeper
behaviours.how: Keeps clients and debts in a spreadsheet and is proud of it.

behaviours.name: Bitrix24 or amoCRM user
behaviours.how: Already pays for a CRM, finds it complicated or slow, but has set it up.

behaviours.name: Price comparer
behaviours.how: Asks three vendors for prices, picks the cheapest that works, tries free tiers first.

behaviours.name: Asks other owners
behaviours.how: Buys software only after a friend or competitor says they use it.

behaviours.name: Wants it done for them
behaviours.how: Pays to avoid setup; will not spend an evening importing data.

objections: $89 a month is a lot when Bitrix24 has a free plan
Who else uses it? I cannot find any company I know
I would have to move all my clients and retrain my staff
Is my customer data safe on your server, and are there backups?
AI calls and voice are not working yet, so why would I pay for them
I cannot tell which of your plans I need
habits: you take most orders and questions from clients in Telegram
you pay suppliers and receive money through Click and Payme
you check the shop or office numbers on your phone in the evening
you ask friends who run businesses which tools they use
